register_torchxla_trivial_backend: register the torchxla_trivial backend as an experimental backend for PyTorch Dynamo
register_openxla_backend: register the openxla backend for compiling PyTorch models with XLA acceleration
compile_model_with_openxla: compile a PyTorch model using the openxla backend with boxed=True for AOT autograd
create_aot_torchxla_trivial_compiler: create an AOT autograd compiler wrapper around torchxla_trivial for experimental XLA compilation
run_xla_backend_helper: run the xla_backend_helper to extract and compile a graph using torch_xla dynamo_bridge
